# Lives Implementation Plan
> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task.
**Goal:** Account lives with daily top-up, win progress, rewarded revival and animated pentagon HUD.
**Architecture:** Supabase locked ledger/RPC and verified ad callbacks; SwiftUI client authorizes rounds online and reconciles persisted settlements.
**Tech Stack:** Swift/SpriteKit, PostgreSQL, Google Mobile Ads Swift Package, Supabase Edge Functions.
**Spec:** docs/superpowers/specs/2026-10-29-lives-design.md
## Global Constraints
Daily max(5,current), lives 0...99, progress 0...90 by tens; mandatory auth; no fabricated ad rewards; EN/JA/KO; iOS17.
## Review Focus
- Retry/duplicate settlement must not double charge or double award.
- Midnight, backward clock and balance above five preserve the correct amount.
- Network failure retains pending settlement and blocks next round.
- Early ad close/load failure and repeated SSV never grant extra lives.
- Rapid navigation/account change cannot apply a response to another account.

- [x] Add supabase/migrations ledger, begin/settle/status/ad-ticket functions with row locking, RLS and least privilege.

- [x] Add Google Mobile Ads package/test configuration; RewardedAds.swift, verified callback Edge Function and replay tests.

- [x] Build, inspect screenshot, review and record remaining deployment requirements.
